document_title: POLARIS PRE-REGISTERED HORIZON-CONDITIONAL LOCAL-SPATIAL 3X3 FORECASTING EXPERIMENT PROTOCOL
scientific_question: Does adding a causal 3x3 local AROME cloud-state representation to the existing POLARIS forecasting inputs improve causal SW_IN forecasting under the locked POLARIS benchmark?
experiment_type: Single Pre-Registered Forecasting Validation Experiment (NOT an information audit)

absolute_firewalls.feature_governance: No new meteorological variables or derived features permitted. The only newly constructed representation is the pre-registered 3x3 spatial tensor formed directly from the existing frozen 11-channel causal AROME cache.
absolute_firewalls.footprint: Local 3x3 patch centered at station grid point y=209, x=548 (patch y=208..210, x=547..549)

frozen_architecture_spec.spatial_readout: center feature [1,1] (16d), flattened 3x3 (144d) -> Linear(144,32) -> BN1d(32) -> ReLU
frozen_architecture_spec.horizon_gate: concat(spatial_rep 32, horizon_emb 16) -> Linear(48,32) -> ReLU -> Linear(32,32) -> Sigmoid -> elementwise mult with spatial_rep
frozen_architecture_spec.fusion_head: concat(gated_spatial 32, context 32, horizon_emb 16) = 80 -> Linear(80,32) -> ReLU -> Dropout(0.2) -> Linear(32,1)

training_protocol.spatial_scaling: Per-channel Z-score standardization fit on training fold only, clipped to [-5, +5]
training_protocol.loss_function: Daytime MAE / L1Loss with causal night zero mask

even_evaluation_gates.G1: Aggregate daytime ΔMAE <= -0.50 W/m² vs control (47.451469 W/m²)
even_evaluation_gates.G2: At least 4 of 5 folds improve in daytime MAE
even_evaluation_gates.G3: Maximum fold daytime MAE degradation <= +0.50 W/m²
even_evaluation_gates.G4: Daytime nMAE <= 36.8045% AND Daytime RMSE <= 74.376601 W/m²
even_evaluation_gates.G5: 0 parser, shape, or temporal leakage defects

decision_rules.if_any_fail: REJECTED and local-spatial route CLOSED permanently. No retraining, rescue models, or seed sweeps.
